text:
lina: Quick UX sync on the private setup preflight summary. Goal: single compact card, collapse probe logs by default, clear next steps when checks fail. Thoughts?

matt: Compact card sounds great. Suggest a single status pill + short line of copy, chevron to expand.

devon: When collapsed, lazy-load probe rows on expand. Keyboard: chevron button with aria-expanded; focus moves into list when opened and Esc collapses.

samira: For screen readers use polite aria-live for progress ('Connection checks: 1 of 4 complete'). Announce final result with counts. Add visible text for icons.

lina: Microcopy: running: 'Running connection checks (2/4)'; success: 'Connection checks completed — all reachable.' partial: '3 passed, 1 failed. Expand for fixes.' CTA: 'Retry failed checks' or 'Contact support'.

matt: Make docs link secondary; primary action only when actionable. Consider tiny 'copy diagnostics' inline in expanded view.

devon: Backend should emit incremental summary events so UI avoids polling. Include short remediation hints in payload.

samira: Contrast check: pill text must meet AA. Spinner aria-hidden + text readout.

qa-bot: perf-preview built for PR #4333 — https://deploy.preview/redwood/panel/4333

lina: Action items: Matt mock today, Devon add aria hooks + event consumer, Samira keyboard/reader pass, QA will smoke test. I'll schedule a 15-min signoff. Thanks!
